item.title: Massive Explosion Expected Of World's Deadliest Creature In New York
item.description: Experts warn that a "warm and wet" 2026 summer will trigger a massive explosion of the world's "deadliest" creature in New York

item.title: Will You Be Abducted? New York Shockingly High Alien Odds
item.description: New York is one of the top spots in the nation for alien abductions and UFO sightings.

item.title: New York Schools Removing Clocks Because Kids Can't Read Them?
item.description: Some schools in New York are ditching analog clocks for digital ones, reflecting students’ struggles with reading time traditionally and igniting a conversation about fundamental skills in education.

item.title: New York State Home To Three Of The Best Buffets In America
item.description: A new report ranked the best buffets in the nation. Turns out, New York State has three of the best. Two are in the Hudson Valley!

item.title: "Fan-Favorite" To Perform "Must-See" Show In Upstate New York
item.description: He's been a best-selling author and a TV star for over a decade. Plus, there's a chance to win $60,000. We've got all the details.

item.title: Why This Is Expected To Be The Worst Tick Season Ever In New York
item.description: Experts are sounding the alarm that 2026 could be one of the worst tick seasons on record in New York State, and the Hudson Valley is right in the crosshairs.

item.title: 50-Year New York Fishing Ban Finally Ends
item.description: For the first time in five decades, families can officially feast on fish from this iconic river. See which catches are finally back on the menu.

item.title: IBM Building Fire Linked To TikTok Trend In New York
item.description: A suspicious fire at the vacant IBM facility in the Hudson Valley is likely connected to a growing dangerous social media trend.

item.title: Why This Upstate New York Pastor Was Arrested Before Easter
item.description: An Upstate New York church leader was just accused of shocking crimes with a young child just before Easter.

item.title: New Color for State Vehicles in New York?
item.description: In a lighthearted April Fools' prank, NYSDOT teased swapping yellow for pink to help drivers notice their trucks better, sparking a lively conversation about road safety.

item.title: Health Alert For Great Value Dino Chicken Nuggets Sold At Walmart
item.description: A public health alert has been issued for Great Value Dino Chicken Nuggets sold at Walmart, possibly containing unsafe lead levels. Health officials stress the risks, especially for young kids and pregnant women.

item.title: Pinwheel Gardens Sprout In Westchester, Each Symbolizing A Child's Story
item.description: Bright blue pinwheels are popping up around the Hudson Valley, symbolizing Child Abuse Prevention Month and reminding us of the serious need for safer childhoods for all kids.

item.title: What Happened To This Once Thriving Wappingers Plaza?
item.description: Only two businesses remain in what was previously a packed plaza in a busy stretch of Route 9 in Wappingers.

item.title: Ride This 'Scenic Time Capsule' Train Through New York's Catskills
item.description: Here's your chance to hop on a vintage train and take a nostalgic 90-minute scenic ride through the heart of the Catskills, winding you through 1600s farmlands and mountain forests.

item.title: Oh No: This Quarter-Century Old Poughkeepsie Business Now Closed For Good
item.description: This Market Street Poughkeepsie mainstay has officially closed after serving the area for 25 years.
